title: Active Processlist
description: Show all active running connections and queries. Helps spot blocking or slow queries currently running.
sql:
SELECT ID, USER, HOST, DB, COMMAND, TIME, STATE, INFO
FROM information_schema.processlist
WHERE COMMAND != 'Sleep'
  AND INFO IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY TIME DESC;

title: Fix Blocked Hosts & Connection Errors
description: Mengatasi error klasik 'Host is blocked because of many connection errors' dengan me-reset cache host dan menaikkan batas max_connect_errors.

title: Inspect & Adjust Max Connections
description: Memeriksa batas jumlah koneksi simultan MySQL dan menaikkan kuotanya secara dinamis tanpa perlu me-restart server.

title: Find Tables by Column Name
description: Mencari nama tabel dan skema mana saja yang memiliki kolom tertentu di seluruh database MySQL.
sql:
SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE column_name = 'nama_kolom'
  AND table_schema = DATABASE() -- Atau ganti dengan 'nama_database' spesifik
ORDER BY table_name;

title: Server Version & SQL Mode Info
description: Memeriksa versi detail server MySQL serta mode SQL (strict mode, only_full_group_by) pada level global dan sesi.

title: Database Sizes
description: Calculate total size of all databases on the server, detailing data size, index size, and total size in MB.
sql:
SELECT table_schema AS database_name,
       ROUND(SUM(data_length + index_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS total_size_mb,
       ROUND(SUM(data_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS data_size_mb,
       ROUND(SUM(index_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS index_size_mb
FROM information_schema.tables
GROUP BY table_schema
ORDER BY total_size_mb DESC;

title: Table Size Breakdown
description: Show total size, row count, and average row length for all tables in a specific database.
sql:
SELECT table_name,
       table_rows AS row_count,
       ROUND((data_length + index_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS total_size_mb,
       ROUND(data_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS data_size_mb,
       ROUND(index_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS index_size_mb
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
ORDER BY total_size_mb DESC
LIMIT 20;

title: Tables Without Primary Key
description: List all tables in the current database that lack a primary key, which can cause performance issues (especially in replication).
sql:
SELECT tab.table_schema, tab.table_name
FROM information_schema.tables tab
LEFT JOIN information_schema.table_constraints con
  ON tab.table_schema = con.table_schema
  AND tab.table_name = con.table_name
  AND con.constraint_type = 'PRIMARY KEY'
WHERE con.constraint_name IS NULL
  AND tab.table_schema = DATABASE()
  AND tab.table_type = 'BASE TABLE';

title: InnoDB Lock Waits
description: Show which transactions are blocking which, along with the query details. Useful for debugging lock timeouts.
sql:
SELECT 
  r.trx_id waiting_trx_id,
  r.trx_mysql_thread_id waiting_thread,
  r.trx_query waiting_query,
  b.trx_id blocking_trx_id,
  b.trx_mysql_thread_id blocking_thread,
  b.trx_query blocking_query
FROM sys.innodb_lock_waits w
INNER JOIN information_schema.innodb_trx b
  ON b.trx_id = w.blocking_trx_id
INNER JOIN information_schema.innodb_trx r
  ON r.trx_id = w.requesting_trx_id;
